notes.title: Performance Optimization & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
✅ Improvements
- Reduced frame drop issues in certain sections for a smoother gameplay experience.
- Optimized collision detection for more accurate and efficient object interactions.
- Lowered background and visual effects load to improve performance on low-spec systems.

🐞 Bug Fixes
- Fixed a problem where sound settings were not applying correctly.
- Minor UI and text display bugs have been corrected.
